item.title: Version 2.2.0
item.description:
## New
- **Meetings can be named after your calendar event.** Turn on "Name Meetings after calendar events" (Settings → General), and a Meeting recorded during "Design review" is called "Design review" in the list and its Meeting file, instead of a date or a guessed title. - **It picks the real meeting.** Only events with other people or a call link (Meet, Zoom, Teams, …) count, so "Focus" or "Lunch" blocks never name a Meeting. The event is matched against the whole recording, so joining a few minutes early doesn't name it after the previous meeting. All-day, cancelled and declined events are skipped. - **Optional, and asked once.** OpenOats asks for calendar access only when you turn it on: from Settings, the optional Calendar row in onboarding, or a one-line tip on a finished Meeting ("Turn On · Not Now"). Say Not Now and it won't ask again.
Your calendar is read on this Mac when a recording stops and isn't sent anywhere. With the setting off, nothing changes. A title you set by renaming still wins.
